title: Run the Story Notes checks in half their time

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage report

Verdict: Caught.

Story and revision: SEED-404#run-the-story-notes-checks-in-a-third-of-their-time (.planning/seeds/SEED-404-run-dashboard-frontend-checks-at-doughnut-speed.md; plan .planning/slice-plans/713-run-the-story-notes-checks-in-a-third-of-their-time/PLAN.md). Checked revision 0542cce46d0fdc7a1fd39fff17b3bf0706519550, in an isolated detached scratch worktree (/Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/aaf2d10e/tmp/ic-scratch, npm ci, clean `git status` before the probe). The scratch worktree has been removed.

Promise: "Story notes opens beside an attached terminal on the mounted board, and the terminal stays connected and shows output printed while notes was open." (seed key example; it matches the caller's suggestion.)

Fault (one of the suggested options; checked against the code): dashboard/src/attachedTerminal.ts, in the socket "message" handler. Text output frames are dropped (an early return before terminal.write) while a `dialog.story-notes[open]` element is present. The edit also logs an "IC-WITNESS" line for each frame it drops. This models losing terminal output that arrives while Story notes is open. No fixtures, test support or assertions were changed. The diff is in ic-evidence/fault.diff.

Command (run from the scratch checkout): env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_FRONTEND_PROOF_RECORD=<ic-evidence>/<phase>-proof.json npm run test:dashboard:frontend -- stories/story-notes-terminal

Maintained check examined: dashboard/frontend-tests/stories/story-notes-terminal.mounted.spec.ts, "Story notes leaves an attached terminal mounted and connected". It uses the fixture-answered socket from attachedTerminal()/sessionTerminal() in dashboard/test-support/mounted-dashboard/mountedSessionTerminal.ts.

Observations:
- Baseline: passed. 1 test ran in mounted Chromium, 1466 ms; Vitest Duration 2.66 s. Load average was about 3.8.
- Faulted: failed (exit 1). The independent witness line in the run output was `IC-WITNESS dropped output while Story notes open: "Terminal while notes open\r\n"`. This shows that the fixture's print, made while the dialog was open, reached the product handler and was discarded on the intended path. The catch was `screen.expectText("Terminal while notes open")` at spec line 27, via mountedSessionTerminal.ts:43 (`expect.poll(rowsText).toContain(text)`): AssertionError, expected 'Terminal before notes ' to contain 'Terminal while notes open'. The terminal showed only the output printed before notes opened. The test ran 2386 ms; Duration 3.21 s.
- The claim is limited to this path: output dropped while the dialog is open. This probe did not exercise the remount/socket-close variants. The spec's `originalScreen.isConnected` and `attachments() === 1` assertions cover those variants, but they were not reached here because the test failed earlier at line 27.

Restoration: the original file was restored from a saved copy, with a shell trap as backup. After restoring, `git status --short` matched the empty pre-probe state and `git diff` was empty, at HEAD 0542cce46. The same command then passed: 1 test, 1062 ms; Duration 1.86 s; no IC-WITNESS line. The scratch worktree was then removed with `git worktree remove --force` and pruned. Nothing was committed or pushed. The execution checkout was never edited.

Next proof action: none is needed for this promise path. The maintained assertion catches dropped output. Optionally, a separate probe could fault the remount/socket-close variant to exercise the isConnected/attachments assertions. No already-planned repair or prior disposition applies; this probe introduces no new repair decision.

Costs:
- Test runtime: Vitest Duration across the three focused runs: baseline 2.66 s, faulted 3.21 s, restored 1.86 s; total 7.73 s. Per-test 1466, 2386 and 1062 ms. npm ci and worktree setup not timed separately.
- Human effort: unavailable.
- Agent effort: unavailable.
- Invocation-to-report elapsed: 80976 ms (measured).

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision 0542cce46d0fdc7a1fd39fff17b3bf0706519550, verdict Caught, no follow-up.
